# CodeWizardsHQ

> > Online coding school offering live, instructor-led classes for kids ages 8-18, teaching Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Scratch, and web development with pathways to high school internships.

CodeWizardsHQ provides structured coding education through real-time online classes, emphasizing computational thinking, problem-solving skills, and professional development practices. The platform serves students nationwide with comprehensive curricula from beginner Scratch projects to advanced web application development using frameworks like Flask and MVC architecture.

## Key Topics

- Python programming
- JavaScript
- HTML & CSS
- Scratch
- Web development
- Computational thinking
- Problem-solving skills
- Coding for kids ages 8-18
- High school internship program
- MVC Framework & ORM
- Parent guides for coding education
- Critical thinking development
- Online learning for kids
- STEM education
- Minecraft coding

## Coding Courses & Programs

- [CodeWizardsHQ Professional Web App Development High School](https://www.codewizardshq.com/pro-web-application-development): High school web development course using Flask, Python, and Jinja2
- [Coding Classes for Kids Near Trenton, NJ | Ages 8-18](https://www.codewizardshq.com/coding-classes-near-me/coding-classes-trenton): Trenton, NJ coding classes for ages 8-18 with Scratch, Python, JavaScript
- [Coding Classes for Kids in Jacksonville | CodeWizardsHQ](https://www.codewizardshq.com/coding-classes-near-me/coding-classes-jacksonville): Jacksonville, FL online coding classes for ages 8-18 with internships
- [Coding Classes for Kids in Newark | CodeWizardsHQ](https://www.codewizardshq.com/coding-classes-near-me/coding-classes-newark): Newark, NJ online coding programs with Python, JavaScript, and HTML
